subject: Private deployment packaging: quantization & compression options
messages:
From: Alex Singh <alex.singh@medicore.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment packaging: quantization & compression options

Hi Dylan / Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks for the pilot demo last week — impressed with the latency and the observability hooks. We are starting procurement conversations internally for a VPC/private deployment and need clarity on a few packaging/pricing items before we proceed:

1) Quantization/Compression: Does Redwood charge a separate license for running quantized models (e.g., int8/q4_0) and for the compression layer you showed? Is that a one-time conversion fee or a per-node runtime license?

2) Platform fee anchoring: Our finance team prefers a capped platform fee vs. a large upfront entitlement. Can you explain typical anchoring approaches (annualized vs. amortized) and whether you offer smoothing credits?

3) Warranty & SLA credits: We need a sample clause that ties platform fee credits to latency/availability, and a clear SRE on-call tier (response and escalation windows).

4) Support tiers: What are the response SLAs for Standard vs. Enterprise (P1/P2), and do you offer an accelerated remediation add-on?

Attached is our procurement questionnaire and a rough sizing note for expected nodes (estimate: 8-12 inference nodes initially). Would prefer a written commercial sketch we can share with procurement by end of week.

Appreciate a quick run-down and a ballpark commercial.

Best,
Alex
Alex Singh
Procurement Manager, Medicore AI
procurement@medicore.ai

Attachments: medicore-procurement-questionnaire.pdf

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
To: Alex Singh <alex.singh@medicore.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment packaging: quantization & compression options

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear asks and for sending the questionnaire. High level answers to start, followed by a suggested commercial sketch.

1) Quantization & compression licensing:
- Conversion/quantization: one-time model-prep fee for converting/validating the model artifacts for the private runtime (covers safety checks and validation). Typically a flat engineering effort charge (we bill as a fixed professional services line).
- Runtime compression: we treat the compression/optimized kernel as an optional add-on. Pricing is per-active-node per-month; discounted at scale (nodes > 10).

2) Platform fee anchoring:
- Two options we use: annualized platform fee (paid upfront or monthly amortized) or monthly platform subscription with a usage floor. For procurement simplicity we can propose a "smoothed" approach: 50% of platform fee amortized over 24 months and a consumption floor that reconciles annually.

3) Warranty & SLA credits:
- We can include a performance credit matrix: credits triggered for sustained P95 latency breaches or availability below SLA. Credits are capped (typical cap = 12.5% of quarterly platform fee). We can provide sample wording in the SOW.

4) Support tiers:
- Standard: P1 (8 hour response), P2 (24 hour), business hours coverage.
- Enterprise: P1 (1 hour response), P2 (4 hour), 24x7 support, named SRE on-call and weekly runbooks.

5) Pilot / Commercial sketch (ballpark):
- 24-month commitment preferred
- Platform fee: $60k/year (smoothed option available)
- Quantization conversion: $12k one-time (per major model)
- Compression runtime add-on: $1,200/node/month; discount 25% for nodes beyond 10
- Enterprise support add-on: $18k/year for named SRE and 24x7 coverage

I'm attaching a simple pricing sheet (privdeploy-pricing-sheet-v1.xlsx) and the quantization safety notes (quantization-safety-notes.pdf). If it helps, Kimberly can propose an anchored concession for a 24-month commit.

Next step: would you like a consolidated commercial sketch (numbers + sample SOW + credit clause) for procurement review? Happy to set a 30-min alignment with procurement.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: privdeploy-pricing-sheet-v1.xlsx, quantization-safety-notes.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
To: Alex Singh <alex.singh@medicore.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment packaging: quantization & compression options

Alex — quick note from procurement/commercial side with a concrete concession we can offer to get the deck over the line.

Proposal (concession):
- Waive the onboarding / conversion fee (quantization conversion) if Medicore signs a 24-month commitment within 30 days.
- Platform fee first-year discount: 20% off the quoted $60k for year 1; year 2 full price unless you choose smoothing (we can amortize).
- Compression runtime: 30% discount for nodes above 10 (so node 11+ would be $840/node/month).
- Warranty credits: increase credit cap to 15% of quarterly platform fee for the first 12 months during pilot; thereafter revert to 12.5%.
- Enterprise support add-on: trial at no charge for 60 days during pilot (subject to SOW).

We are comfortable putting the above in a commercial memo for procurement. Would you prefer the 24-month firm commit or a staged pilot-to-production with a conversion waiver tied to conversion to production? The staged pilot option is more flexible but delays the onboarding fee waiver until production acceptance.

Kimberly Park
Head of Commercials, Redwood Inference

Thanks — this is helpful. A few clarifying asks from procurement and infra: 

- The conversion waiver tied to a 24-month commit is attractive, but can you reduce the platform fee cap for year 2 if we achieve certain usage thresholds? Finance wants a built-in step-down if run-rate stays low after year 1.

- For warranty credits: can we negotiate a higher credit cap for availability (e.g., 20%) if the issue is on Redwood side (not customer misconfiguration)? Procurement wants stronger protections for production workloads.

- SOW / sample clause: can you share a short SOW snippet showing remediation timelines, root cause analysis commitments, and the escrow/rollback triggers? That will accelerate legal.

Attached is our filled procurement questionnaire (medicore-procurement-questionnaire.pdf). Also, please confirm the compression runtime licensing model — per active inference node or per GPU? We run multi-GPU pods and need to align pricing with physical GPUs.

Appreciate a redlineable doc for procurement review. If we can get a commercial sketch + SOW by tomorrow we can schedule procurement legal for Thu.

Best regards,
Alex

Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround. Finalizing a draft commercial and SOW now; summary and suggested next steps below.

Commercial sketch (final ask):
- Commitment: 24 months (pilot to prod cadence allowed)
- Platform fee: $48k for year 1 (20% discount), $58k for year 2 with a step-down clause: if average monthly consumption (measured tokens/hour equivalent) is < 60% of forecast for 3 consecutive months in year 2, platform fee reduces to $44k for remaining term (mutual review required).
- Quantization conversion: waived at signature if 24-month commit within 30 days; otherwise $12k one-time.
- Compression runtime: priced per-GPU-equivalent active instance at $1,200/GPU-month; discount to $840 for GPU count beyond 10. Pricing applies to active GPUs used for inference (we will provide usage metering hooks).
- Warranty credits: For Redwood-origin faults (confirmed RCA), we will increase the credit cap to 20% of quarterly platform fee for the first 12 months. For customer-caused incidents, standard credit cap (12.5%) applies.
- Enterprise SRE: 60-day trial during pilot; thereafter $18k/year unless otherwise negotiated in SOW.

SOW deliverables (excerpt):
- Remediation timeline: P1 mitigation within 4 hours (temporary mitigation), full RCA within 5 business days. P2 mitigation within 8 business hours, RCA within 10 business days.
- Rollback/escrow trigger: customer may invoke rollback if 3 or more P1 incidents in a rolling 90-day window attributable to Redwood.
- Observability: token-level tracing and per-request latency dashboards provided as agreed in onboarding checklist.

Next steps:
1) I will upload a redlineable commercial memo + short SOW to the shared link: https://redwood.example.com/sow/drafts/medicore-privdeploy-v1.docx (copy attached above).
2) Proposed 30-min procurement sync: Thu 2027-07-01 at 10:00 AM PT — please confirm or propose another time.
3) If Medicore signs within 30 days we will apply the conversion waiver and year-1 platform discount as outlined.

If that aligns, Kimberly will draft the commercial memo for signature and Marissa will coordinate the SOW and onboarding checklist.

Thanks — talk soon.

Dylan
Director, Solutions, Redwood Inference
